title: Welcome Screen
subtitle: Build the first screen of the app, then test that Get Started opens Home.

nodes.label: Drag a Header into the Header zone
nodes.note: The title bar at the top of the phone.

nodes.label: Type the school name: Alrowad International Schools
nodes.note: Properties panel, Text content, then press Enter.

nodes.label: Drag a Logo into the Body, type the school name on it
nodes.note: The logo shows the initials AI.

nodes.label: Command: ADD TEXT "Welcome to our dismissal app!"
nodes.note: Typed in the Commands tab, then Run Commands.

nodes.label: Drag a Card, then SET TEXT "Request Dismissal"
nodes.note: Select the card on the phone first.

nodes.label: Command: ADD CARD two more cards
nodes.note: Two ADD CARD commands, one per line.

nodes.label: Drag a Button into the Action bar, label it Get Started
Command: LINK BUTTON "Get Started" TO "Home"
nodes.note: This is what makes the button open the Home screen.

nodes.label: Style the screen: gradient header, navy logo, teal buttons
nodes.note: Exact choices are listed in the guide.

nodes.label: Run Project and tap Get Started
nodes.note: The studio shows a demo, then you tap it yourself.

nodes.label: Does Get Started open the Home screen?
Check the LINK command and the button name
Home screen is shown with the module tiles
